text:
ravi: Heads-up — after the GPU onboarding window last night eu-west control plane saw repeated etcd leader elections and short apiserver 5xx spikes. Noticed it ~00:02 UTC and it's been noisy until ~00:21 UTC.

emily: Confirmed on metrics — etcd commit latency spiked to ~120ms, leader changes ~6x in 20m. apiserver goroutine counts jumped too.

sam: Any networking changes during onboarding? We rolled new firewall rules and a restrictive networkpolicy to isolate workload pods.

ravi: Yes — network-policy 'gpu-onboard-restrict' applied to onboarding namespace at 23:58 UTC. I suspect peer connections between controlplane nodes had brief drops.

joyce: I pulled coredns/apiserver logs and saw a bunch of gRPC EOFs to etcd endpoints. Short excerpt: 
```
2026-02-18T00:03:05Z apiserver: error streaming watch: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
2026-02-18T00:03:06Z etcd[leader]: forced leader stepdown: etcdserver: request timed out
```

sam: That matches. If networkpolicy blocked ephemeral ports or ICMP, TCP retries could starve keepalives and cause raft timeouts.

emily: Ops-bot alerted on rho-alert:apiserver-5xx at 00:05. I paged oncall and started a rolling rollback of the networkpolicy to test.

ops-bot: action=rollback networkpolicy=gpu-onboard-restrict namespace=onboard triggered_by=emily at=2026-02-18T00:09:12Z

ravi: After rollback we saw leader elections stop after ~3 minutes. apiserver 5xx rate returned to baseline. However, we still see degraded KV cache hit rates and slightly elevated token costs due to increased watch churn.

joyce: Churn caused our apiserver to re-list resources more often — watch reconnects -> full re-list -> more tokens. Cost impact estimate: additional ~12k token equivalents in that 30 min window for eu-west.

sam: Two quick mitigation proposals: 1) pin ephemeral port ranges in the networkpolicy to allow controlplane-peer connections. 2) temporarily increase etcd election timeout (tick-based) or tune apiserver keepalive to tolerate short drops. Thoughts?

emily: Prefer minimal config change first — update networkpolicy to include controlplane CIDR + ephemeral ports. If problem persists, consider bumping etcd election timeout (but that affects failover speed).

ravi: I agree. Also we should consider lowering controller-manager and scheduler resync periods for onboarding bursts to reduce list pressure. Could do a canary change on a single prov group.

joyce: Logging the sequence and creating a follow-up ticket for cost/regression: "gpu-onboard: netpolicy caused etcd leader churn and watch re-list cost". Assign to infra-team for postmortem.

sam: I'll send a small patch to the networkpolicy in the onboarding helm release: allow tcp ports 30000-32767 from controlplane-nodes, and add a note about ephemeral ranges in docs.

emily: FYI added a short-term alert tweak: increase apiserver-5xx alert threshold for eu-west by 3m to avoid paginating on short onboarding windows. We'll revert after the rollout stabilizes.

ops-bot: incident_log: created ticket INFRA-4821, severity=low, owner=infra-team, summary="netpolicy -> etcd election drift during GPU onboarding"

ravi: Action items summary: 
- sam: patch networkpolicy to explicitly allow controlplane ephemeral ports (PR queued).
- joyce: write postmortem TODO and cost estimate.
- emily: monitor for 6 hours and revert temporary alert tweak after.
- ravi: run a small canary of controller-manager resync tuning next onboarding.

sam: PR is up: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/1973 — change is small, targeted, will not affect prod-other namespaces.

emily: Nice. I'll coordinate with platform release to apply during the low-traffic window and watch etcd leader metrics.

joyce: Putting a note for long-term: consider adding an eBPF check to simulate networkpolicy rulesets against controlplane peers before applying. Would have avoided this.

ravi: Agreed. Also add a cheaper mitigation for future: enable prefix KV caching for high-churn resources during onboarding windows to cut token and CPU cost.

sam: Applying the patch in ~10m. Will post results.

emily: Thanks. Also tagging @oncall-eu for visibility. :eyes:

ops-bot: deployment=networkpolicy/gpu-onboard-restrict status=applied at=2026-02-18T00:39:02Z

sam: Post-patch: etcd commit latency back to ~18ms, leader changes 0 in last 15m, apiserver 5xx at baseline. Closing thread unless anyone sees regressions.

joyce: Closing notes added to INFRA-4821. Will schedule a 1hr retro next week to cover preflight checks and cost guardrails.

ravi: Thanks team. Good catch on rolling back quickly.
